verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear hierarchy, with the headline dominant and the body text and CTA in one row, but the '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' eyebrow is tiny and sits apart under the logo instead of above the headline, and the fine print is too small to read. B blows the eyebrow up to near-headline weight with a bad '24 / READERS' line break, which competes with the headline; the body text is jammed between it and a CTA stranded far right, and the book cover butts against the card edge.
